description: Use this when the user wants a satellite image or aerial photo of an area as a file for QGIS: a recent true colour picture, a false colour image, or NDVI to see vegetation, crops or forest health. The area is a bbox, a place, or a place with a radius. Two sources: IGN orthophotos (France only, about 0.5 to 1 m pixels, areas up to 2 x 2 km; the default inside metropolitan France for true colour) and Copernicus Sentinel-2 L2A (worldwide, 10 m, a scene every few days, areas up to 20 x 20 km; the default elsewhere and for false colour, NDVI or a date). For Sentinel-2 it picks the least cloudy scene covering the whole area in the date range (default: the last 60 days, at most 20 % cloud) and says its date, id and cloud cover. Returns a GeoTIFF in the source's own projected CRS (UTM or Lambert-93) with the licence in the file, and a preview on a map. Not for street-level photos, live weather or a picture more recent than a few days; to explain what NDVI or a band is, answer without this tool. Never use the user's current location unless they type it. Download links build their file when opened; no file is saved. Never pass these links to open_gis_file.

area.description: The area: a bbox, or a place (name, address or coordinates) with an optional radius in metres. The place the user asks about, not the user's own location.

bbox.description: [west, south, east, north] in decimal degrees (WGS 84).

place.description: A place name or address, or a point.

radius_m.description: Radius around the place in metres.

date_from.description: Sentinel-2: start of the date range, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: 60 days before date_to.

date_to.description: Sentinel-2: end of the date range, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today.

max_cloud_percent.description: Sentinel-2: highest cloud cover of the whole scene, in percent.

product.description: Sentinel-2 only. true_color; false_color (B08, B04, B03: vegetation in red); ndvi (float32, NaN where cloud, shadow, snow or no data).

source.description: ign_ortho: IGN orthophotos, France only, true colour. sentinel2: Copernicus Sentinel-2, worldwide, 10 m. Default: ign_ortho inside metropolitan France for true colour without a date, sentinel2 otherwise.

name: get_satellite_image

downloads.description: Download links; each builds its file when opened.

hint.description: What to do next, on errors only.

sources.description: Data sources and licences of the result.
